caption:
✈️ The FAA stopped all US departures for over four hours. Flying this weekend? Check your flight, delays continued Saturday.
📧 Outlook, Teams and Copilot went down worldwide for two workdays. Missing emails should be arriving now.
⚖️ The Supreme Court will rule on Trump's asylum restrictions, decision expected by summer 2027.
🌧️ Floods in Gaza's tent camps: WHO reports rising respiratory infections.
🇵🇪 Pope Leo XIV made an emotional return to Peru.

Were you hit by the flight stop or the Outlook outage? 👇

Cover: Overloaded routers grounded US flights
🎨 AI-generated image

1/5 US flights grounded for hours (4h 21m)
The FAA halted all US departures for over four hours Friday. Overloaded, old network gear knocked out radar and communications.
🎨 AI-generated image

2/5 Outlook down for two workdays (130K)
Outlook, Teams and Copilot went down worldwide from Thursday. Businesses and governments around the world lost access to email.
📷 AnonymousUnknown author (CC0) via wikimedia

3/5 Supreme Court takes asylum case (2027)
The Supreme Court will hear Trump's border asylum restrictions case. Lower courts ruled it unlawful, yet it stays enforced.
📷 Joe Ravi (CC BY-SA 3.0) via wikimedia

4/5 Floods hit Gaza's tent camps (90)
Heavy rain has flooded Gaza tents since 6 November. WHO says respiratory infections are rising among the displaced.
🎨 AI-generated image

5/5 Pope Leo returns to Peru (Peru)
Pope Leo XIV celebrated Mass in Pimentel, near Chiclayo, Peru. He once served as bishop there; crowds cheered his return.
📷 Ceterni Perú (CC BY-SA 4.0) via wikimedia
